title: Satya Nadella has issued a shocking warning to companies using AI
slides: What did Nadella see that you haven't?
He warns AI will soon automate entire workflows.
But most firms still treat it as a toy.
Your current tools could become obsolete overnight.
Test your stack against his latest demo now.
thread_text:
1. Are you watching the right demo?

Satya Nadella just showed a workflow that runs entirely without human clicks. Not a chatbot trick.

2. The toy phase is over.

Most companies still use AI for drafts or summaries. That gap is already costing them.

3. Your stack has a shelf life.

Tools you bought last year can't chain agents. Nadella's demo skipped three vendors entirely.

4. Obsolete isn't tomorrow.

For one team it's already today. They replaced a five-step pipeline with a single prompt.

5. Test your own workflow tonight.

Copy your most annoying recurring task. Ask the latest model to run it end-to-end. What breaks?

Satya Nadella just showed an AI workflow that runs entirely without a single human click — and warned that most companies are still treating this as a toy. ⚠️

The Microsoft CEO says AI will soon automate complete workflows, not just write drafts or summaries. Your current tools can’t chain agents together — and that gap is already costing you.

He demonstrated a pipeline that skipped three entire vendors. For one team, their five-step manual process is already replaced by a single prompt.

What's the most annoying recurring task on your plate right now? Try to make the latest model run it end-to-end tonight — and watch where it breaks. 🧨
